w:r.w:t: 1941 Chevrolet Coupe – Bought for $50 from Grandma Fidler. Named Black Sam, rebuilt engine in Engine Shop, it had knocking rods.
1929 Chrysler Roadster – In neighbor’s yard. Bought with Don Holm. Never got running, towed to junk yard, no brakes, exciting ride.
1934 Chevrolet – Never got running. Bought from Tom Lind.
1951 Ford Convertible – From Hartman
1950 Ford Sedan – Dropped the rear end burning rubber at Lewis and Clark Theatre. Sold to Peterson
1947 Mercury, sold or gave to Gary
1949 Chevrolet Convertible. The one I had was baby blue. – sold to Harrison

1949 Dodge. Named the Slug, bought from Bob Garrity, my mentor. This is what it looked like when I sold it, was a real pretty black color when I bought it. Bob ended up drowning near Willapa Bay a few years ago.

1954 Nash Rambler – bought from Mike Dawson, I think this was the model. Drove to Mexico with Peterson, this one ended up in the junk yard after struggling back to Seattle and suffering a major indignity during and afterwards.
1955 Pontiac from Gjersee, sold to Gary who put 4 on the floor. Second favorite car. There is an interesting story about a young cop getting shot in this car.
1956 Chevrolet Coupe – from Kniss’s reliable used cars. Burned oil like crazy.
1963 Volvo pv544, first new car, got stuck in the Ocean one night not long after I bought it, totaled it.
1960 Volvo, not as nice as the stuck in the Ocean model.
1961 Triumph TR3 – blue. Drag your knuckles on the ground while driving.
1963 Pontiac Grand Prix – I loaned this to Beth before we were married to drive to work. Had from 1967 to 1969
1972 Chevrolet Vega, we bought this one new, blew the engine. We bought one and so did Dapper
1972 Ford Mustang $3000 new. Shoulda kept it.
1960 TR-3 Bought in 1973 – Favorite car of all time for me. Had to sell to get an adult car with 2 kids. Sold for $1000 in 1974.
Motorcycles Yamaha 80CC. Amazing how much power you have with 80 CC
Bultaco Matador. FUN, did a lot of hill climbing and off road stuff.
63 BSA Gold Star. One lung, Hard to start but fun once it did. Beth rode on this one and loved it (I think).
1969 BSA Thunderbolt. Rode this one to California with Mike Irving. Great Bike. Rode the Big Sur a few times, once with Beth
1963 Ford Van – kids rode around in back in a play pen. They slept well while traveling, we don’t sleep so well now thinking about how dangerous it was..
1977 Ford Van – made into a camper. The girls got their first and only spanking on a quarrelsome trip to Idaho in this Van.
1981 Datsun Station Wagon. Compact piece of junk.
1979 Fiat Spider. Nice car.
1986 Peugeot 505 Turbo. Turbo blew TWICE, OK car but expensive to own.
1987 Jeep - Robyn and Lisa learned to drive in this, both abused the poor thing. They shared an exciting experience when they spun out on I90 driving up to the pass in the snow.
1981 Fiat Spider. Another nice car.
1989 Alfa Spyder Veloce. Had from 1990 till 2017. Great car, should have driven it more.
1997 Lexus ES 300. Should have lasted forever.
1990 Ford Pickup from Bill Small. Good truck, 4WD
2003 Ford Pickup Great truck, standard shift with roll up windows. Mitch & Lisa now are the proud owners of this classic..
2012 Lexus ES 350 Maybe our last car? Who knows. They should last forever??
